faqs.question: Will a motherboard fit my laptop?
faqs.answer: Motherboards are specific to the laptop model and processor. Send us your laptop model, or a photo of the sticker under the laptop, on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: How do I know the motherboard is my problem?
faqs.answer: A laptop that won't power on, has no display, restarts by itself or has stopped charging may have a faulty motherboard, but the fault can also be the charger, battery, RAM or screen. Send us the symptoms on WhatsApp and we'll help you check before you buy.

faqs.question: Can I fit a motherboard myself?
faqs.answer: The laptop has to be taken apart to reach the board, so most customers have it fitted by us. Tell us your model on WhatsApp and we'll say what the job involves.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with motherboards?
faqs.answer: Motherboards ship with warranty as noted on each listing. Message us on WhatsApp for the current term before ordering.
